candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;` in the first branch, so _BASE_TARGET_ is no longer reset when RState is BELOW_ONE and base reserve is below target.
Delete the statement `_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;` in the second branch, so _BASE_TARGET_ is no longer reset when RState is ABOVE_ONE and quote reserve is below target.
In the first branch, replace `_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;` with `_BASE_TARGET_ = _QUOTE_RESERVE_;` so a different value is written to _BASE_TARGET_.
In the second branch, replace `_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;` with `_BASE_TARGET_ = _QUOTE_TARGET_;` so a different value is written to _BASE_TARGET_.
Change the first branch condition `_BASE_RESERVE_<_BASE_TARGET_` to `_BASE_RESERVE_>_BASE_TARGET_`, so the reset of _BASE_TARGET_ occurs in different states.
Change the first branch condition `_RState_ == uint32(PMMPricing.RState.BELOW_ONE)` to `_RState_ == uint32(PMMPricing.RState.ONE)`, so the reset of _BASE_TARGET_ triggers in different states.
